meta.name: My Name Is Farah
meta.description: Farah is a 28-year-old Iranian doctor who works illegally as a cleaner in Istanbul and witnesses a murder committed by the mafia.

videos.name: Black Fish
videos.overview: Farah, who fled Iran and had to stay in Istanbul when she found out she was pregnant; She starts to work as a cleaning worker instead of her main profession as a surgeon. Farah managed to be both a mother and a doctor to her son Kerimşah, who has PID known as congenital balloon disease; There is nothing she can't do for her son and his treatment. One night, she comes face to face with Tahir Lekesiz on the occasion of the tragic event she unwittingly witnessed in a cleaning place. Tahir; He is one of the top members of a family business dealing with illegal business and is a loyal man to his boss who saved his life and raised him at a young age. But that night, he finds himself in an unexpected situation for the first time. While Farah is torn between keeping quiet or speaking out for justice, Tahir has to decide for the first time in his life about the fate of an innocent woman and child.

videos.name: White Lamb
videos.overview: Farah could not escape her fate once again and was caught by Tahir. While Ali Galip's saving his life keeps her alive for now, she and Tahir begin to wait for Ali Galip's decision for her. Although the decision he made about this woman and her son, who saved Ali Galip's life but also threatened his son's life, gives Farah a sigh of relief for now, the future is uncertain. Tahir, on the other hand, gets into a dead end with Ali Galip's real decision. Tahir, who fulfills every order of the boss who has taken care of him all his life, is stuck somewhere between his heart and mind this time. Will he take the life of an innocent woman and leave a sick child motherless in this life, or will he help Farah survive? As time is running out, Mehmet gets closer to figuring out who the woman in Tahir's car was on the night of the murder. Gönül, on the other hand, is not even aware that she is about to establish a close relationship with the murderer of her childhood friend.

videos.name: Black Lamb
videos.overview: Farah, whose son's life is at risk, is unaware that Tahir, whom she has asked for help, is originally assigned to eliminate her. As AGA says; Will the woman's gaze and the child's laughter be able to seep through Tahir's skin as he has shelved his conscience? On the other hand, as Mehmet approaches Farah step by step, it becomes more difficult for Farah to escape from Mehmet. Retired chief Orhan finds himself in the middle of unexpected events; Seeing Vera in her neighborhood means remembering unpleasant memories for Perihan. Gönül will meet again with Kaan, whom she knows under the name Emir, and her blood will warm up even more. The AGA's disposition on Farah is worse than killing, and a very tough test awaits Farah.

videos.name: Little Sah
videos.overview: When Tahir pulls the trigger in Farah's place, it causes a very new problem between Aga and Tahir. Is the affiliation over, has the hostility begun? Aga will make Tahir pay a heavy price for disobeying his order. Farah has no one left to rely on to survive, but Tahir. While Tahir protects Farah and Kerimşah, neither of them knows that Kerimşah has told Mehmet everything. When Farah learns that Mehmet is talking to Kerimşah, she warns him to stay away from her son. Meanwhile, Mehmet; he will tell Farah the past of Tahir, whom he trusts, with evidence and ask her to make the right decision for herself.

videos.name: Every Bird Flies To Its Own Kind
videos.overview: With the good news of the donor from Tahir, Farah stops testifying to Mehmet. Mehmet has no intention of letting Farah go. After the events, Aga and Tahir have a big showdown and an uncertain process begins for Tahir, where he must protect both Farah and himself. When he realizes that he cannot break Farah's stubbornness with beauty; Mehmet decides to play the game harder. His goal is to make Farah think she will be deported and force her to testify. When events unexpectedly spiral out of control, Farah's fear of deportation becomes a reality. Tahir has to race against time to save Farah. Farah may be saved by Tahir's efforts, but this adventure has opened the door to a new problem that Tahir and Farah could not foresee.

videos.name: Two Stubborn Goats
videos.overview: Tahir is very disappointed to learn that Farah is lying. Farah, who thinks that he will no longer be able to stay at Tahir's house and is preparing to return home, finds Tahir in front of her. Although Tahir gives her another chance, Farah cannot give up her own truth and it is inevitable they will face each other. An unexpected surprise guest knocks on Farah's door, who has no choice but to testify, in order to solve all her problems. Farah is impressed by Tahir's surprise offer. However, in the meantime, Mehmet learns that Gönül's boyfriend is Kaan, he sees nothing and arrests Kaan. The deal Mehmet will offer to Tahir will deflect all events in another direction.

videos.name: Chocolate Thief
videos.overview: Farah and Tahir become fugitives, not knowing the fate of Bekir. At the cost of his own life, Tahir will hide the mother and son in a chalet where no one can find them. While thinking of saving Farah, her son and sacrificing himself, he has one last wish; Spending a peaceful last day like a family… Will Farah understand what Tahir is hiding and what to do? Farah will share her past with someone for the first time. With Tahir Lekesiz. Mehmet thinks that he has solved the murder. But there's one thing he forgets: One way or another, the truth comes out. Did Kaan really commit the murder? Or is there a conspiracy behind it? The balances within the Akıncı family will change and be shaken after Bekir's stabbing and Kaan's arrest. Ali Galip's threatening visit to Orhan will open the veil of the past a little more. Do these two men have a common sin from the past? Nothing will ever be the same for Tahir, Farah or the Akıncılar family.

videos.name: Farah Lekesiz
videos.overview: Ali Galip's order to kill the chief commissioner of Mehmet is a difficult task for Tahir to accept. On the other hand, getting rid of Mehmet will be the key to starting a new life for Tahir. While Tahir struggles with this dilemma, Farah struggles with a completely different feeling. She realizes that she is starting to fall for Tahir. Gönül and Perihan left to stay with Farah, unaware that Tahir and Farah's wedding will be at Ali Galip's house. While many secrets are revealed, at the very moment of signing, the house is raided with a gun and the marriage does not take place. Although Tahir and Farah can't get married, this adventure will bring them closer. Meanwhile, Tahir is moved away from the idea of killing Mehmet, but when Mehmet learns from Bade that he will be assassinated, he is furious and holds Tahir responsible. But what neither of them knows is that the incident that pitted them against each other was actually the result of another story that pre-empted their fates...

videos.name: Maybe One Day
videos.overview: Tahir walks the path of becoming a family with Farah. Now is the right time to express your feelings. 'Declare I love.' A surprise to Farah will also turn Farah upside down. Farah will now have to make a decision. Maybe it's time to face up to being both a mother and a woman. Although they are not aware of Mehmet and Tahir's journey, it will not be the same as before. Can two brothers be enemies? Can they stay the same if they know they are siblings? While Tahir is trying to clean up his life, Mehmet won't let him raise his head. As you dig into Tahir's past, a truth that Farah does not know will come to light. What happened to him in his youth? How will Farah feel when she faces this? The radical decision Kaan and Gönül make with their lives will deeply affect both families. The Akıncıs and Koşaners are destined to reunite again after many years. So, is it our past that makes us who we are, or is it our present? Tahir and Farah will be tested by the answer to this question.

videos.name: I Hide You From Myself
videos.overview: After what happened in the hospital, a while passed, and after Farah's reaction, Tahir stayed away from Farah and Kerimşah, and put aside the dream of an ordinary happy life that returned to his essence. But the fact that Tahir and Farah's marriage will be controlled by the authorities changes everything. Mehmet has stopped dealing with Tahir and is pursuing bigger goals. The clue he is looking for comes across unexpectedly... Gönül and Kaan's return from their honeymoon and Koşanerler and Akıncılar's forced marriage turns into a situation that Perihan cannot accept when Gönül settles in Akıncılar's house. Perihan is alone on the way to win her daughter back. Although Tahir and Farah have to stay together out of necessity, no matter how many obstacles they put between themselves, their every move brings them closer to becoming a family. As they count down the days for Kerimşah's recovery, new developments are in the offing, where they will realize that it will not be easy.

videos.name: Mother Lion
videos.overview: The death of the donor changed everything. Farah feels that this death was not a simple accident. Although Tahir hides this from Farah, he is after the doer and the mentor. As a result of Tahir's reckless action, everything is turned upside down. Tahir and Farah must take refuge in a more sheltered AGA's house. Mehmet, on the other hand, is now sure of a leak in the police while investigating what the black lamb and white lamb is. What is this black lamb white lamb network? Who's behind it? It's the right move for Bade, who learns that his uncle had the donor killed, to tell this information to the chief inspector Mehmet? And will Farah be able to hide from her love for Tahir, no matter what happen?

videos.name: Je T'aime
videos.overview: Farah learns from Mehmet that it was Ali Galip who killed Kerimşah's donor. Tahir goes after the one who killed the donor. On the other hand, he needs the information he will find through Mehmet, and the two men pursue a common enemy for the first time. As they move one step closer to revealing the White Lamb Black Lamb organization; Ali Galip and Orhan are aware of this danger. Forced to cooperate under Mehmet's pressure, Farah has only one goal, to leave everything behind and go away with Tahir and her son. However, the information that Tahir has reached with the step he has taken regarding the salvation of Kerimşah leaves him in a conscientious dilemma. Either he will share this information with Farah, which will be hope for Kerimşah, or he will gamble with Kerimşah's future and walk towards the future he imagined with Farah. While dealing with this dilemma, Tahir ignited a new problem that developed out of his control, causing a sleeping giant to wake up.

videos.name: Make a Wish
videos.overview: Farah gets to her feet after learning that Behnam is alive. Tahir's good intentions, the possibility of Kerimşah's salvation and the sticking of the unknown in Iran awakened the sleeping giant. Who is this Behnam, what is his power? What will he do when he learns that he has an heir? What kind of fate awaits Tahir and Farah, who dream of a new life? The pen that Farah placed in the house of Ali Galip will bear fruit, and Mehmet will discover the physical meeting of the White Lamb and the Black Lamb through listening. Unaware that the black lamb is the chief Orhan, what will happen to Mehmet while he is chasing this meeting? Bade and Farah will be the prime suspects when the security leak is learned. What will Aga do when he finds out about this betrayal? Farah is now both on Aga's radar and on her child's father's radar.

videos.name: No Return
videos.overview: Hearing the attack on the vehicle with Bade and Farah, Mehmet and Tahir immediately rush to the hospital where they were taken. Farah is in shock. Bade underwent serious surgery. It will again fall to Farah to calm Tahir, who is chasing who did the attack, and to include him in the big plan he is in with Bade and Mehmet. However, Tahir has another plan in his mind, in which Ali Galip imposes his own sentence. Orhan and Ali Galip, on the other hand, came very close to realizing the plan to settle the big shipment and go underground. What they don't know is that now they have a team that knows their plans. Although Farah fears Tahir's silence, it's not over yet; She dreams of the day she leaves with the man she loves and her son Kerimşah. Gönül and Kaan's wedding may be the last peaceful night. Everyone who is next to each other, watching the bride and groom dance at the wedding that night, will jump into action for the great war they will fight the next day.

videos.name: Repentance
videos.overview: Behnam finally found Farah, who tried to kill him. Well, what about Kerimşah? Farah cares about her own son? Behnam wants to make sure of this first. Of course, he will want to make Farah, who has left him and whom he later learns is married to another man, experience the greatest pain of all. And when Tahir learns that his happy family dream is shattered, and that his wife, Farah and Kerimşah, are being held by Behnam, he will do everything in his power to save them. However, things will not go as he wants and he will be cornered by the trap set for him. When a year passes, Tahir, who spent this time in prison, and Farah, who is virtually a prisoner of Behnam, will face each other in a courtroom. Because Farah wants to divorce Tahir. Tahir, on the other hand,  cannot make sense of this and instead of getting a divorce, he chooses to resist until the end, risking everything.

videos.name: Most Far, Very Close
videos.overview: Mehmet's awakening means Tahir's salvation. Tahir, who was released from prison a year later, still says that Farah wants to divorce him and wonders whether she is under Behnam's influence and whether she acts like this because she is afraid of him and what he will do to her. Tahir loves Farah too much to ever give up on her. What about Farah... In the past year, has she forgotten Tahir? Tahir needs to be sure of this. He must find a way to be alone with Farah to talk to her about everything. Behnam's mother, Rahşan, is disturbed by Farah's presence and sees with great sadness that her son's feelings for this young woman are growing stronger day by day. A plan she set up to get rid of Farah surprisingly succeeds.

videos.name: Awakening
videos.overview: Tahir, who was thrown down from the construction by Behnam, will be saved by someone he never expected. Farah, on the other hand, will fall into a great void, thinking that Tahir is dead. While Behnam tries to make Farah helpless and weak, he will face the fear of losing her and realize once again how much he loves her. Farah and Tahir, unaware of each other, will start to fight against Behnam and his tyranny, without giving up. Tahir will not hesitate to use even Mehmet, who trusts him, for this purpose, and will obtain very important information that will shake Behnam's power. Since it has been a year since the loss of Ali Galip, Vera will want to activate her husband's will by filing a lawsuit for absence. However, two surprises await them in Ali Galip's will that will change all balances.

videos.name: Reunion
videos.overview: Tahir becoming a partner in the company, the disappearance of Haluk, who transferred his shares to Tahir, and all these changing and uncertain situations make Behnam's connections in Iran uneasy and Behnam is forced to go to Iran. In Behnam's absence, Farah is ready to reunite with Tahir and dissuade him from this revenge plan. However, the meeting between Farah and Tahir and the events that follow lead to the revelation of secrets. Ali Galip's will is opened and the person to whom he left the company shares will surprise everyone. Mehmet, on the other hand, remembers something completely different but very important while trying to remember who shot him.

videos.name: This is Turkey!
videos.overview: Determined to rescue Farah from the place where she lives with her son, Tahir needs the help of a surprise name to get the image that Behnam keeps in the safe. Farah has no intention of remaining unresponsive to Behnam, who is turning Kerimşah against Tahir. The arrival of the great-uncle Mahmoud Azadi from Iran changes all the balances. Not only Farah, but also the Azadi family is affected by this situation, and Behnam wants to prove to his uncle Mahmoud that he is in control. A bad surprise awaits Mehmet, who returns to his duty and takes action to find his brother. While Tahir, who is very close to getting the image back from the safe, encounters an unexpected situation, Farah is cornered by Behnam's wedding surprise. videos.name: A New Beginning
videos.overview: Tahir, who could not escape the clutches of Mehmet and the other police officers despite all his efforts, has no choice but to confront his brother. Mehmet's world comes crashing down when he learns that Tahir is the criminal he is looking for. As Mehmet takes Tahir to the police station, a surprise visit takes the tension between the two brothers to an unexpected level. On the other hand, Farah, who escapes at the last moment from being caught thanks to the system established by Orhan, learns about Behnam's last big move at the cost of burning himself. Farah comes up with a plan with Bade and Gönül to prevent this. Farah's flawless plan turns into chaos when she learns that Tahir is working with Orhan. Farah and Tahir put their heads together and look for a solution to get out of this complicated situation. The only way to end all this chaos is through a final showdown with Behnam. Behnam, who has nothing left to lose, has no intention of giving up.
